_comment: Fleet benchmark transport/build config -- the single source of truth for HOW the orchestrator (optimizer/orchestrate/00_run_fleet.py) reaches each hardware target. The (app x backend x hardware) MATRIX lives in fleet-coverage.json; this file says, per friendly hardware name: the --device id passed to the binaries, the deploy transport (ssh host / adb serial+host), the local build/ dir holding its binaries, which GPU backends it runs, and optional per-app schedule-candidate caps. Replaces the transport details previously scattered across 03_run_schedule.py + scripts/run-on-*.sh + the justfile (and fixes the justfile's stale jetson host: it is yanwen@duck-stable, reachable directly from this box, NOT duck-naughty).
